globalNews.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
globalNews.summary: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

globalNews.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
globalNews.summary: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.

globalNews.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
globalNews.summary: Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave in 2021.

globalNews.title: Crowd of 50 beats foreigner to death in South Africa
globalNews.summary: The attack on the unidentified victim follows a wave of anti-migrants protests in South Africa this year.

globalNews.title: Germany target of 'intensive' espionage, Merz says after suspected Russian spy arrest
globalNews.summary: A Ukrainian man was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia - one of several such cases in Germany this year.

cryptoNews.title: Underdog taps zerohash to bring crypto deposits to prediction markets
cryptoNews.summary: The new funding option, expected to launch later this year, will allow eligible Underdog users to deposit digital assets around the clock.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
cryptoNews.summary: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.

cryptoNews.title: Irish cenbank fines Coinbase arm $3.6M for oversight, safeguard failures
cryptoNews.summary: According to the Central Bank of Ireland, Coinbase Ireland had agreed with the facts around the enforcement action and will be subject to fines and sanctions upon approval by a high court.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin circles $81.5K ETF cost basis as Trump Iran comments send stocks lower
cryptoNews.summary: Bitcoin extended daily losses to 3% as US stocks came under pressure from President Donald Trump’s comments on Iran military action.

cryptoNews.title: Fireblocks disputes report of $2.5B Visa acquisition talks
cryptoNews.summary: Fireblocks told Cointelegraph that reports of a potential $2.5 billion acquisition by Visa are “not true at present time,” while Visa declined to comment on the reported talks.

aiNews.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
aiNews.summary: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.

aiNews.title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
aiNews.summary: The ride-share giant previously deployed a much smaller pilot for ChatGPT Work but is now taking the enterprise agent company-wide.

aiNews.title: Spotify’s current AI bet is about being the music service that agents choose
aiNews.summary: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström explains why the rise of AI agents could be good news for the music service.

aiNews.title: Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
aiNews.summary: Claude Duet is available through waitlist for Pro and Max plan users.

aiNews.title: Nirva raises $33M for a pendant that only listens to you
aiNews.summary: Nirva will ship its $249 ambient AI pendant by the end of the year.
